name: 奶油肌暖调气垫粉底霜款
description: 暖调奶油米与柔玫粉体系，开盖主图到海绵微距、半脸对照与空色卡收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, creamy ivory #F6E7D7 and soft rose-blush #EBC0BC fields for benefit and mechanism screens, deep berry-magenta #A21B52 reserved for the closing panel
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm high-key studio light from a large soft front key with bounce fill, low contrast, gentle contact shadows, controlled specular only on mirror lids, no hard shadow edges
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy reflective acrylic sheet #F3DAD3 for benefit screens, matte creamy board #F6E7D7 for mechanism screens, seamless matte paper #FFFFFF for packshots
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif in deep charcoal #3B3033 with generous letterspacing; source lettering stripped so every copy block stays an empty held-out zone
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight rules and small solid dot markers in berry-magenta #A21B52 only
styleLock.presentationRules: compact always shown open with the hinged lid back at a stable slight 3/4 to high 45-degree angle, puff kept as the only companion object, consistent compact scale across all screens
noDrift: no shade numbers or sun-protection figures rendered anywhere
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium dewy base-makeup visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, creamy ivory #F6E7D7, soft rose-blush #EBC0BC and one berry-magenta accent #A21B52; warm high-key studio lighting from a large soft front key with bounce fill, low contrast, gentle contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif in deep charcoal #3B3033 with generous letterspacing; hairline rules and small solid dot markers in berry-magenta #A21B52 as the only icon language; glossy reflective acrylic surface with soft mirror bounce; stable slight 3/4 to high 45-degree product angles and consistent compact scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用开盖储液海绵加粉底涂抹带交代品类与妆效
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down onto the open compact, full product visible and unclipped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, large soft front key with bounce fill on the shadow side, soft contact shadow, gentle specular on the mirror lid
shots.props: one round applicator puff at the lower right and one wide foundation smear band behind the case
shots.whitespace: none, the subject fills the vertical frame with even margins
shots.promptTemplate: Clean marketplace packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The compact is shown open with its hinged lid tilted back and the round applicator puff resting at the lower right, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down so the saturated sponge reservoir reads clearly, while one wide smooth foundation smear band sweeps diagonally behind the case in {accent_color}. Bright even high-key studio lighting from a large soft front key with a bounce card on the shadow side, soft contact shadow grounding the case, gentle specular on the mirror lid. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace and no copy area. 4K vertical main-image crop. Negative: no invented logos or added lettering on the case or puff, no shade numbers or sun-protection figures, no hands, no watermark, no cut-off edges, no tinted or gradient background, no duplicated puff, no dry cracked-looking sponge surface.

provenance.notes: 源 6 张主图逐图事实：001 纯白底开盖气垫＋粉底涂抹带＋圆形粉扑；002 镜盖半开的立镜产品照置于亮面反光台面，右半为纯色文案面板；003 六格拼图（三格文字块＋俯拍于粉底涂抹带上的开盖气垫、镜中反射眼部上妆、粉扑拍颊）；004 竖向半脸左右对照＋三条编号使用步骤；005 米色面板上一叠切片海绵被粉底液浇淋的机制图＋左侧文字块；006 上排四格色号试色卡＋下排两款并置选装面板。品类判定依据：全部画面主体为着色彩妆底妆单品（气垫粉底霜与配套粉扑），非护理清洁类，故归「美妆彩妆／底妆」，与源类目提示一致；源图仅 006 上排为色卡式陈列，其余 5 张各有可复用分镜，故不按变体画廊处理。已剥离内容：品牌字标与盖面字样、粉扑缎带字样、系列名、全部原文案句与标题、色号编号与防晒数值（色号展示位改为 {accent_color} 空卡，不写任何数字）、模特可辨识面容（一律改为颈下或眼部以下裁切的通用面孔）、平台徽章与评价角标；所有功效与规格主张改为空白占位卡与留白条，产品一律以 {product} 占位。
